name: @inneranimalmedia/agentsam-desktop-shell
description: Tauri desktop shell for AgentSam-powered brand dashboards — manifest-driven, multi-brand installs.

scripts.build: node scripts/build-brand.mjs local-studio && node scripts/sync-local-studio-dist.mjs && tauri build
scripts.typecheck: echo "agentsam-desktop-shell: no TS surface yet" && exit 0
scripts.test: node --test scripts/sync-local-studio-dist.mjs 2>/dev/null || echo "agentsam-desktop-shell: sync script present"

author: Sam Primeaux <sam@inneranimalmedia.com>
